snippets.snippet_text: "I'm not even kidding, this single reason is enough to quit using Gumroad entirely. Sure, they are a free tool to use when you're just starting, but come on, A transaction fee of 10% + 0.50 per sale is way off the roof."

"Gumroad keep removing my followers. So, I could have a list of 1708 and come back to 1704 the next day. Basically, my list is pretty unstable. Email marketing is supposed one of the more stable marketing channels for a business but Gumroad doesn't make it easy."
